data.name: Gabriel India Ltd
data.about: Gabriel India is part of ANAND Group. The Company has established a significant presence across all automotive customer segments, including OEMs, Aftermarket, and exports. Company manufactures over 500 models of ride control products.[1]Its products include shock absorbers, struts, front forks and others.[2]

data.what_it_does: Gabriel India Limited is a diversified automotive components manufacturer supplying shock absorbers, struts, front forks, sunroof systems, fasteners, and lubricants to OEMs and the aftermarket across two-wheelers, passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and railways, with growing exports.

bull.text: Strong return metrics with ROCE of 26%, low leverage at 0.11 debt-to-equity, and operating cash flow covering PAT 1.07x over three years.
Quarterly revenue grew sequentially from ₹1,179 Cr in Dec 2025 to ₹1,426 Cr in Jun 2026 while PAT rose from ₹55 Cr to ₹108 Cr over the same period.
Management targets ₹50,000 Cr group revenue by 2030 and estimates content per vehicle could reach ₹60,000-70,000, implying significant per-vehicle revenue upside.

bear.text: New business EBITDA margin target of 12-14% has delivered only 8.7% in the first of four tracked quarters.
Management acknowledged the ₹1,000 Cr revenue aspiration for 2030 may slip by one to two years.
Planned debt increase of ₹1,000 Cr in the short-to-medium term plus USD 98.44 million in acquisition payments could raise leverage from the current 0.11 debt-to-equity.
